description: lookup_mta_sts_txt (production) contains the TXT record parsing inline. parse_sts_record and select_sts_record in the #[cfg(test)] block replicate the same parsing to make it unit-testable. These are two separate implementations that must be kept in sync. The fix: extract a pure fn parse_sts_record_text(text: &str) -> Result<Option<MtaStsTxtRecord>, MtaStsError> at the module level (not under cfg(test)). lookup_mta_sts_txt calls it; the tests also call it. One implementation, one set of tests.
title: parse_sts_record in cfg(test) duplicates production parsing logic
